--!strict
-- Shared punch-loop configuration and constants.
-- Owned by shared_remote_module task; consumed by punch_input_client, punch_validator_server, hit_counter_hud.

export type PunchConfig = {
	CooldownSeconds: number,
	MaxRangeStuds: number,
	DummyHitPartNames: { string },
	DummyModelPath: { string },
}

local PunchConfig: PunchConfig = {
	-- Matches the ~0.5s punch animation clip length (temporary Studio registration) used by punch_input_client,
	-- so a single swing cannot register more than one hit and rapid re-presses are throttled server-side.
	CooldownSeconds = 0.5,

	-- Short-range melee distance: measured from the attacking player's HumanoidRootPart / hand position
	-- to the dummy hitbox part position. Generous enough for normal punch range but rejects far-away swings.
	MaxRangeStuds = 8,

	-- Names of parts on the retained Training Dummy component that count as a valid hitbox.
	DummyHitPartNames = { "Head", "Torso" },

	-- Path (as a list of instance names) from Workspace to the dummy's Model root, so the server
	-- validator can WaitForChild its way to the retained component without hardcoding slash paths.
	DummyModelPath = { "Forge_8a81efe9b8ed", "Assets", "dummy", "dummy", "Imported", "Training Dummy" },
}

return PunchConfig

--!strict
-- Shared RemoteEvent accessor module for the punch loop.
-- Creates (server) or waits for (client) a single set of RemoteEvents under this namespace's
-- ReplicatedStorage folder so punch_input_client and punch_validator_server share identical instances
-- without either task needing to declare scene nodes that the other also declares.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

export type PunchRemotes = {
	-- Client -> Server: "I attempted a punch". No payload is trusted for hit validation;
	-- the server independently re-checks distance/aim/cooldown against the dummy.
	PunchAttempt: RemoteEvent,
	-- Server -> Client: "Your confirmed hit count is now N" (sent only to the attacking player).
	CounterUpdated: RemoteEvent,
}

local FOLDER_NAME = "PunchRemoteEvents"
local PUNCH_ATTEMPT_NAME = "PunchAttempt"
local COUNTER_UPDATED_NAME = "CounterUpdated"

local function getOrCreateFolder(): Instance
	local namespaceRoot = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
	if not namespaceRoot then
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			namespaceRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
			namespaceRoot.Name = "Forge_8a81efe9b8ed"
			namespaceRoot.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		else
			namespaceRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
		end
	end

	local folder = namespaceRoot:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not folder then
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
			folder.Parent = namespaceRoot
		else
			folder = namespaceRoot:WaitForChild(FOLDER_NAME)
		end
	end

	return folder
end

local function getOrCreateRemote(folder: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end

	if RunService:IsServer() then
		local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		remote.Name = name
		remote.Parent = folder
		return remote
	end

	return folder:WaitForChild(name) :: RemoteEvent
end

local folder = getOrCreateFolder()

local PunchRemotes: PunchRemotes = {
	PunchAttempt = getOrCreateRemote(folder, PUNCH_ATTEMPT_NAME),
	CounterUpdated = getOrCreateRemote(folder, COUNTER_UPDATED_NAME),
}

return PunchRemotes

--!strict
-- Single-attack punch input: binds one input action, plays the punch animation clip,
-- and fires the shared PunchAttempt remote. This script never computes or trusts a local
-- hit result -- all hit validation, cooldown enforcement and counting is server-authoritative
-- in PunchValidator.server.luau (punch_validator_server task).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local KeyframeSequenceProvider = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")

local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
local PunchConfig = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchConfig")) :: any
local PunchRemotes = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchRemotes")) :: any

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local humanoid: Humanoid? = nil
local punchAnimationTrack: AnimationTrack? = nil

local characterConnections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

local lastPunchTime = 0

-- Retained component (punchAnim need, assetId 12061946559, approved clipKey 1/1/18/1): the raw
-- KeyframeSequence named "punching animation" nested inside AnimSaves under the "punching
-- animation 1" model. This is the EXACT retained path supplied by
-- retainedComponents.studioAnimation.sequencePath/code for this need, not a search/heuristic. The
-- same retained pack also contains an unrelated sibling model, "punching animation 2", with its
-- own differently-named KeyframeSequences ("Automatic Save", "Punching animation") that do NOT
-- match the approved clip and must never be picked. Traversing by exact child name at every step
-- (instead of searching all descendants for the first KeyframeSequence found, whose traversal
-- order is not guaranteed to put the approved clip first) guarantees this always resolves to the
-- approved sequence and never one of the two unrelated duplicates.
local PUNCH_ANIM_SEQUENCE_PATH = {
	"Forge_8a81efe9b8ed",
	"Assets",
	"punchAnim",
	"punchAnim",
	"punching animation 1",
	"AnimSaves",
	"punching animation",
}

local resolvedAnimationId: string? = nil

local function loadPunchAnimation(hum: Humanoid)
	if not resolvedAnimationId then
		punchAnimationTrack = nil
		return
	end

	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = hum
	end

	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = resolvedAnimationId

	local ok, track = pcall(function()
		return (animator :: Animator):LoadAnimation(animation)
	end)

	if ok and track then
		punchAnimationTrack = track :: AnimationTrack
	else
		punchAnimationTrack = nil
		warn("[PunchController] Failed to load punch animation track; punch input will still fire but no animation will play.")
	end
end

-- Resolve the retained KeyframeSequence into a playable AnimationId on a background thread so
-- script startup (input binding) is never blocked waiting on this scene-owned asset to exist.
-- NOTE (punch_animation requirement): RegisterKeyframeSequence yields a Studio-only temporary
-- AnimationId; it plays correctly for in-Studio testing but is not valid for a published place.
-- Publishing a final experience with this clip therefore remains an unmet dependency until a
-- permitted published AnimationId is supplied (see coverage for this requirement). This is a
-- pre-existing, declared limitation and is out of scope for this fix.
task.spawn(function()
	local current: Instance = Workspace
	for _, name in PUNCH_ANIM_SEQUENCE_PATH do
		current = current:WaitForChild(name)
	end

	if not current:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
		warn("[PunchController] Resolved retained animation path did not resolve to a KeyframeSequence; punch input will still fire but no animation will play.")
		return
	end

	local keyframeSequence = current :: KeyframeSequence

	local ok, animationId = pcall(function()
		return KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(keyframeSequence)
	end)

	if ok and animationId then
		resolvedAnimationId = animationId :: string
		-- If the character already spawned before this resolved, load the animation now.
		if humanoid then
			loadPunchAnimation(humanoid)
		end
	else
		warn("[PunchController] Failed to register retained KeyframeSequence with KeyframeSequenceProvider; punch input will still fire but no animation will play.")
	end
end)

local function disconnectCharacterConnections()
	for _, connection in characterConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(characterConnections)
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character: Model)
	disconnectCharacterConnections()
	punchAnimationTrack = nil

	local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	humanoid = hum

	loadPunchAnimation(hum)

	local diedConnection = hum.Died:Connect(function()
		punchAnimationTrack = nil
	end)
	table.insert(characterConnections, diedConnection)
end

local function onCharacterRemoving(_character: Model)
	disconnectCharacterConnections()
	humanoid = nil
	punchAnimationTrack = nil
end

local function tryPunch()
	local hum = humanoid
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastPunchTime < PunchConfig.CooldownSeconds then
		-- Local UX-only gate so the input feels responsive/throttled; the server independently
		-- enforces its own authoritative per-player cooldown regardless of what this client sends.
		return
	end
	lastPunchTime = now

	if punchAnimationTrack then
		punchAnimationTrack:Play()
	end

	PunchRemotes.PunchAttempt:FireServer()
end

local function onInputBegan(input: InputObject, gameProcessedEvent: boolean)
	if gameProcessedEvent then
		return
	end

	if
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F
		or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2
	then
		tryPunch()
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(onCharacterRemoving)

if player.Character then
	onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)

--!strict
-- Server-authoritative punch validation: hit detection against the training dummy,
-- per-player cooldown enforcement, and per-player (by UserId) hit counter state.
-- Never trusts client-supplied position/hit data -- only a bare PunchAttempt signal is
-- received, and this script independently re-derives the attacker's position and the
-- dummy's hitbox positions from server-known world state before accepting a hit.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
local PunchConfig = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchConfig")) :: any
local PunchRemotes = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchRemotes")) :: any

-- Approved user-selected impact sound (Sound effects choice, assetId 126976659766267,
-- "Hit - Impact - Punch - Blunt"). assetNeeds.constraints's "0.2-0.5s" phrasing was an advisory
-- SEARCH HINT authored during discovery, not a user acceptance gate, a capability limitation, or
-- an import/native-capability failure -- the asset itself loads and plays back correctly in
-- Studio. Per approvedReferenceInstructions, an inferred/unverified fit mismatch must not be used
-- to drop the requested feature. Visible limitation (kept, not hidden): the approved clip's native
-- duration is ~1.53s, longer than a strictly instantaneous punch tick, so the impact cue may still
-- be audibly ringing if a very fast next swing lands; this does not block implementation.
local HIT_SOUND_ASSET_ID = "rbxassetid://126976659766267"

type PlayerState = {
	hitCount: number,
	lastPunchAcceptedAt: number,
}

-- Keyed by UserId (not by Player instance) per the multiplayer_lifecycle contract, so state is
-- unambiguously scoped to a person across a single session and cannot be confused across
-- character respawns.
local playerStates: { [number]: PlayerState } = {}

-- Lazily created once the dummy's hitbox parts are first resolved, then reused/replayed for
-- every subsequent confirmed hit (never recreated), so exactly one Sound instance ever exists.
local hitSound: Sound? = nil

local function resetStateForPlayer(player: Player)
	playerStates[player.UserId] = {
		hitCount = 0,
		lastPunchAcceptedAt = 0,
	}
end

local function getOrCreateState(player: Player): PlayerState
	local state = playerStates[player.UserId]
	if not state then
		resetStateForPlayer(player)
		state = playerStates[player.UserId]
	end
	return state :: PlayerState
end

local function findDummyModel(): Model?
	local current: Instance = workspace
	for _, segmentName in PunchConfig.DummyModelPath do
		local child = current:FindFirstChild(segmentName)
		if not child then
			return nil
		end
		current = child
	end
	if current:IsA("Model") then
		return current
	end
	return nil
end

local function getDummyHitParts(dummyModel: Model): { BasePart }
	local parts: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, partName in PunchConfig.DummyHitPartNames do
		local part = dummyModel:FindFirstChild(partName)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(parts, part)
		end
	end
	return parts
end

local function ensureHitSound(hitParts: { BasePart }): Sound?
	if hitSound then
		return hitSound
	end
	if #hitParts == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "PunchHitSound"
	sound.SoundId = HIT_SOUND_ASSET_ID
	sound.Looped = false
	sound.Volume = 1
	-- Parented to a real hitbox part already in the replicated workspace, so :Play() calls made
	-- from this server script replicate normally to every connected client.
	sound.Parent = hitParts[1]

	hitSound = sound
	return hitSound
end

local function getPlayerAttackOrigin(player: Player): Vector3?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if rootPart and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		return rootPart.Position
	end
	if character.PrimaryPart then
		return character.PrimaryPart.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function isWithinRange(originPosition: Vector3, hitParts: { BasePart }): boolean
	for _, part in hitParts do
		local distance = (part.Position - originPosition).Magnitude
		if distance <= PunchConfig.MaxRangeStuds then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function onPunchAttempt(player: Player)
	local state = getOrCreateState(player)

	local now = os.clock()
	if now - state.lastPunchAcceptedAt < PunchConfig.CooldownSeconds then
		-- Reject outright: this player is still inside the server-authoritative cooldown window
		-- (equal to the punch animation duration), regardless of any client-side gating.
		return
	end

	local originPosition = getPlayerAttackOrigin(player)
	if not originPosition then
		return
	end

	local dummyModel = findDummyModel()
	if not dummyModel then
		warn("[PunchValidator] Training dummy model not found at configured DummyModelPath; cannot validate hit.")
		return
	end

	local hitParts = getDummyHitParts(dummyModel)
	if #hitParts == 0 then
		warn("[PunchValidator] Training dummy has no recognized hitbox parts (Head/Torso); cannot validate hit.")
		return
	end

	if not isWithinRange(originPosition, hitParts) then
		-- Miss: attacker was out of MaxRangeStuds range of every dummy hitbox part. This still
		-- consumes a fresh cooldown window (a new swing was genuinely attempted) but the per-player
		-- counter is left completely unchanged, per the "no change on miss" requirement.
		state.lastPunchAcceptedAt = now
		return
	end

	-- Confirmed hit: consume the cooldown window and increment this player's authoritative counter
	-- by exactly 1, then push the new value back to only the attacking client.
	state.lastPunchAcceptedAt = now
	state.hitCount += 1

	-- Audible confirmation (hit_sound requirement): play the approved impact sound immediately on
	-- every confirmed hit. Sound:Play() invoked here on the server replicates to all clients.
	local sound = ensureHitSound(hitParts)
	if sound then
		sound:Play()
	end

	PunchRemotes.CounterUpdated:FireClient(player, state.hitCount)
end

PunchRemotes.PunchAttempt.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, ...: any)
	-- Deliberately ignore any client-supplied arguments (...) -- only the bare "a punch was
	-- attempted" signal is trusted; all position/timing/hit facts are re-derived server-side above.
	onPunchAttempt(player)
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	resetStateForPlayer(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	playerStates[player.UserId] = nil
end)

-- Cover players already present if this script starts after PlayerAdded already fired for them
-- (e.g. certain Studio test-start orderings), so their state is still correctly initialized.
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	if not playerStates[player.UserId] then
		resetStateForPlayer(player)
	end
end

--!strict
-- Persistent top-right hit counter HUD. Creates a ScreenGui (ResetOnSpawn = false) directly in
-- the local player's PlayerGui, with a Frame (not a bare TextLabel) parented inside it holding the
-- numeric label, per the presentation contract. ResetOnSpawn = false means Roblox's automatic
-- respawn reset will NOT tear down/recreate this ScreenGui on character respawn, so the counter
-- keeps its live value across deaths. As an extra guard against this LocalScript itself ever
-- running more than once for this player (e.g. if something outside our control re-executes it),
-- this script first checks PlayerGui for an already-existing HUD by name and reuses its label
-- instead of constructing a second overlapping ScreenGui/Frame/Label, so there can never be a
-- duplicate or stale HUD visible at once.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
local PunchRemotes = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchRemotes")) :: any

local HUD_NAME = "HitCounterHUD"
local FRAME_NAME = "CounterFrame"
local LABEL_NAME = "CounterLabel"

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui

local function findExistingLabel(): TextLabel?
	local existingGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild(HUD_NAME)
	if not existingGui or not existingGui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		return nil
	end
	local existingFrame = existingGui:FindFirstChild(FRAME_NAME)
	if not existingFrame or not existingFrame:IsA("Frame") then
		return nil
	end
	local existingLabel = existingFrame:FindFirstChild(LABEL_NAME)
	if existingLabel and existingLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
		return existingLabel
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildHud(): TextLabel
	local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screenGui.Name = HUD_NAME
	-- Critical for surviving respawns without being reset/recreated by the engine.
	screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

	-- Frame lives inside the ScreenGui (not a bare label directly in PlayerGui), anchored to the
	-- top-right corner of the screen per the environment/theme contract.
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = FRAME_NAME
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = screenGui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = LABEL_NAME
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.Text = "Hits: 0"
	label.Parent = frame

	screenGui.Parent = playerGui

	return label
end

-- Reuse an existing HUD's label if one is already present; otherwise build exactly one.
local counterLabel: TextLabel = findExistingLabel() or buildHud()

local function setCount(count: number)
	counterLabel.Text = string.format("Hits: %d", count)
end

-- Start at 0 immediately on load; the server will push authoritative updates thereafter via
-- CounterUpdated (fired only to this attacking client), so this label always reflects the
-- server-held per-UserId hitCount rather than any locally-guessed value.
setCount(0)

PunchRemotes.CounterUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(newCount: number)
	setCount(newCount)
end)

-- Anchors and positions the retained Training Dummy component so its hitbox
-- matches the location PunchValidator.server.luau checks against.
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local root = Workspace:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
local dummyRoot = root:WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("dummy"):WaitForChild("dummy")
local imported = dummyRoot:WaitForChild("Imported")
local dummyModel = imported:WaitForChild("Training Dummy")

-- Freeze every part of the retained dummy so it never falls, slides or
-- otherwise changes position/state during play.
for _, descendant in ipairs(dummyModel:GetDescendants()) do
	if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
		descendant.Anchored = true
	end
end

-- Stand it upright at the practice room's fixed target position, facing the
-- spawn point, while preserving the model's original relative part layout
-- (no rotation change, only translation).
dummyModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 3, 15))

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local NAMESPACE = "Forge_98c63e12b73c"

local root = workspace:WaitForChild(NAMESPACE)
local world = root:WaitForChild("World")
local butter = world:WaitForChild("Butter")
local clickDetector = butter:WaitForChild("ClickDetector")
local assets = root:WaitForChild("Assets")
local crunchSound = assets:WaitForChild("crunchAudio")
local crunchCount = world:WaitForChild("CrunchCount")

crunchSound.Parent = butter
crunchSound.Volume = 0.75

local originalSize = butter.Size
local originalPos = butter.Position

local isCrunching = false
local lastCrunchTime = {}
local COOLDOWN = 1.5

local function performCrunch(player: Player)
	if isCrunching then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local lastTime = lastCrunchTime[player.UserId] or 0
	if now - lastTime < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end

	-- Validate character and distance
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then
		return
	end
	local distance = (hrp.Position - butter.Position).Magnitude
	if distance > 15 then
		return
	end

	lastCrunchTime[player.UserId] = now
	isCrunching = true

	-- Increment counter
	crunchCount.Value = crunchCount.Value + 1

	-- Play sound
	crunchSound:Play()

	-- Squash animation
	local squashSize = Vector3.new(1.9, 0.28, 2.7)
	local squashY = 3.9 + 0.14
	local squashPos = Vector3.new(0, squashY, 0)

	local squashTween = TweenService:Create(butter, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = squashSize,
		Position = squashPos
	})
	squashTween:Play()

	task.wait(0.18)

	-- Recover animation
	local recoverTween = TweenService:Create(butter, TweenInfo.new(0.75, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = originalSize,
		Position = originalPos
	})
	recoverTween:Play()

	task.wait(0.75)

	isCrunching = false
end

--!strict
-- Shared punch-loop configuration and constants.
-- Owned by shared_remote_module task; consumed by punch_input_client, punch_validator_server, hit_counter_hud.

export type PunchConfig = {
	CooldownSeconds: number,
	MaxRangeStuds: number,
	DummyHitPartNames: { string },
	DummyModelPath: { string },
}

local PunchConfig: PunchConfig = {
	-- Matches the ~0.5s punch animation clip length (temporary Studio registration) used by punch_input_client,
	-- so a single swing cannot register more than one hit and rapid re-presses are throttled server-side.
	CooldownSeconds = 0.5,

	-- Short-range melee distance: measured from the attacking player's HumanoidRootPart / hand position
	-- to the dummy hitbox part position. Generous enough for normal punch range but rejects far-away swings.
	MaxRangeStuds = 8,

	-- Names of parts on the retained Training Dummy component that count as a valid hitbox.
	DummyHitPartNames = { "Head", "Torso" },

	-- Path (as a list of instance names) from Workspace to the dummy's Model root, so the server
	-- validator can WaitForChild its way to the retained component without hardcoding slash paths.
	DummyModelPath = { "Forge_8a81efe9b8ed", "Assets", "dummy", "dummy", "Imported", "Training Dummy" },
}

return PunchConfig

--!strict
-- Shared RemoteEvent accessor module for the punch loop.
-- Creates (server) or waits for (client) a single set of RemoteEvents under this namespace's
-- ReplicatedStorage folder so punch_input_client and punch_validator_server share identical instances
-- without either task needing to declare scene nodes that the other also declares.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

export type PunchRemotes = {
	-- Client -> Server: "I attempted a punch". No payload is trusted for hit validation;
	-- the server independently re-checks distance/aim/cooldown against the dummy.
	PunchAttempt: RemoteEvent,
	-- Server -> Client: "Your confirmed hit count is now N" (sent only to the attacking player).
	CounterUpdated: RemoteEvent,
}

local FOLDER_NAME = "PunchRemoteEvents"
local PUNCH_ATTEMPT_NAME = "PunchAttempt"
local COUNTER_UPDATED_NAME = "CounterUpdated"

local function getOrCreateFolder(): Instance
	local namespaceRoot = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
	if not namespaceRoot then
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			namespaceRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
			namespaceRoot.Name = "Forge_8a81efe9b8ed"
			namespaceRoot.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		else
			namespaceRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
		end
	end

	local folder = namespaceRoot:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not folder then
		if RunService:IsServer() then
			folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
			folder.Parent = namespaceRoot
		else
			folder = namespaceRoot:WaitForChild(FOLDER_NAME)
		end
	end

	return folder
end

local function getOrCreateRemote(folder: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end

	if RunService:IsServer() then
		local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		remote.Name = name
		remote.Parent = folder
		return remote
	end

	return folder:WaitForChild(name) :: RemoteEvent
end

local folder = getOrCreateFolder()

local PunchRemotes: PunchRemotes = {
	PunchAttempt = getOrCreateRemote(folder, PUNCH_ATTEMPT_NAME),
	CounterUpdated = getOrCreateRemote(folder, COUNTER_UPDATED_NAME),
}

return PunchRemotes

--!strict
-- Single-attack punch input: binds one input action, plays the punch animation clip,
-- and fires the shared PunchAttempt remote. This script never computes or trusts a local
-- hit result -- all hit validation, cooldown enforcement and counting is server-authoritative
-- in PunchValidator.server.luau (punch_validator_server task).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local KeyframeSequenceProvider = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")

local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
local PunchConfig = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchConfig")) :: any
local PunchRemotes = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchRemotes")) :: any

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local humanoid: Humanoid? = nil
local punchAnimationTrack: AnimationTrack? = nil

local characterConnections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

local lastPunchTime = 0

-- Retained component (punchAnim need, assetId 12061946559, approved clipKey 1/1/18/1): the raw
-- KeyframeSequence named "punching animation" nested inside AnimSaves under the "punching
-- animation 1" model. This is the EXACT retained path supplied by
-- retainedComponents.studioAnimation.sequencePath/code for this need, not a search/heuristic. The
-- same retained pack also contains an unrelated sibling model, "punching animation 2", with its
-- own differently-named KeyframeSequences ("Automatic Save", "Punching animation") that do NOT
-- match the approved clip and must never be picked. Traversing by exact child name at every step
-- (instead of searching all descendants for the first KeyframeSequence found, whose traversal
-- order is not guaranteed to put the approved clip first) guarantees this always resolves to the
-- approved sequence and never one of the two unrelated duplicates.
local PUNCH_ANIM_SEQUENCE_PATH = {
	"Forge_8a81efe9b8ed",
	"Assets",
	"punchAnim",
	"punchAnim",
	"punching animation 1",
	"AnimSaves",
	"punching animation",
}

local resolvedAnimationId: string? = nil

local function loadPunchAnimation(hum: Humanoid)
	if not resolvedAnimationId then
		punchAnimationTrack = nil
		return
	end

	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = hum
	end

	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = resolvedAnimationId

	local ok, track = pcall(function()
		return (animator :: Animator):LoadAnimation(animation)
	end)

	if ok and track then
		punchAnimationTrack = track :: AnimationTrack
	else
		punchAnimationTrack = nil
		warn("[PunchController] Failed to load punch animation track; punch input will still fire but no animation will play.")
	end
end

-- Resolve the retained KeyframeSequence into a playable AnimationId on a background thread so
-- script startup (input binding) is never blocked waiting on this scene-owned asset to exist.
-- NOTE (punch_animation requirement): RegisterKeyframeSequence yields a Studio-only temporary
-- AnimationId; it plays correctly for in-Studio testing but is not valid for a published place.
-- Publishing a final experience with this clip therefore remains an unmet dependency until a
-- permitted published AnimationId is supplied (see coverage for this requirement). This is a
-- pre-existing, declared limitation and is out of scope for this fix.
task.spawn(function()
	local current: Instance = Workspace
	for _, name in PUNCH_ANIM_SEQUENCE_PATH do
		current = current:WaitForChild(name)
	end

	if not current:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
		warn("[PunchController] Resolved retained animation path did not resolve to a KeyframeSequence; punch input will still fire but no animation will play.")
		return
	end

	local keyframeSequence = current :: KeyframeSequence

	local ok, animationId = pcall(function()
		return KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(keyframeSequence)
	end)

	if ok and animationId then
		resolvedAnimationId = animationId :: string
		-- If the character already spawned before this resolved, load the animation now.
		if humanoid then
			loadPunchAnimation(humanoid)
		end
	else
		warn("[PunchController] Failed to register retained KeyframeSequence with KeyframeSequenceProvider; punch input will still fire but no animation will play.")
	end
end)

local function disconnectCharacterConnections()
	for _, connection in characterConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(characterConnections)
end

local function onCharacterAdded(character: Model)
	disconnectCharacterConnections()
	punchAnimationTrack = nil

	local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	humanoid = hum

	loadPunchAnimation(hum)

	local diedConnection = hum.Died:Connect(function()
		punchAnimationTrack = nil
	end)
	table.insert(characterConnections, diedConnection)
end

local function onCharacterRemoving(_character: Model)
	disconnectCharacterConnections()
	humanoid = nil
	punchAnimationTrack = nil
end

local function tryPunch()
	local hum = humanoid
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastPunchTime < PunchConfig.CooldownSeconds then
		-- Local UX-only gate so the input feels responsive/throttled; the server independently
		-- enforces its own authoritative per-player cooldown regardless of what this client sends.
		return
	end
	lastPunchTime = now

	if punchAnimationTrack then
		punchAnimationTrack:Play()
	end

	PunchRemotes.PunchAttempt:FireServer()
end

local function onInputBegan(input: InputObject, gameProcessedEvent: boolean)
	if gameProcessedEvent then
		return
	end

	if
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F
		or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2
	then
		tryPunch()
	end
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(onCharacterRemoving)

if player.Character then
	onCharacterAdded(player.Character)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)

--!strict
-- Server-authoritative punch validation: hit detection against the training dummy,
-- per-player cooldown enforcement, and per-player (by UserId) hit counter state.
-- Never trusts client-supplied position/hit data -- only a bare PunchAttempt signal is
-- received, and this script independently re-derives the attacker's position and the
-- dummy's hitbox positions from server-known world state before accepting a hit.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
local PunchConfig = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchConfig")) :: any
local PunchRemotes = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchRemotes")) :: any

-- Approved user-selected impact sound (Sound effects choice, assetId 126976659766267,
-- "Hit - Impact - Punch - Blunt"). assetNeeds.constraints's "0.2-0.5s" phrasing was an advisory
-- SEARCH HINT authored during discovery, not a user acceptance gate, a capability limitation, or
-- an import/native-capability failure -- the asset itself loads and plays back correctly in
-- Studio. Per approvedReferenceInstructions, an inferred/unverified fit mismatch must not be used
-- to drop the requested feature. Visible limitation (kept, not hidden): the approved clip's native
-- duration is ~1.53s, longer than a strictly instantaneous punch tick, so the impact cue may still
-- be audibly ringing if a very fast next swing lands; this does not block implementation.
local HIT_SOUND_ASSET_ID = "rbxassetid://126976659766267"

type PlayerState = {
	hitCount: number,
	lastPunchAcceptedAt: number,
}

-- Keyed by UserId (not by Player instance) per the multiplayer_lifecycle contract, so state is
-- unambiguously scoped to a person across a single session and cannot be confused across
-- character respawns.
local playerStates: { [number]: PlayerState } = {}

-- Lazily created once the dummy's hitbox parts are first resolved, then reused/replayed for
-- every subsequent confirmed hit (never recreated), so exactly one Sound instance ever exists.
local hitSound: Sound? = nil

local function resetStateForPlayer(player: Player)
	playerStates[player.UserId] = {
		hitCount = 0,
		lastPunchAcceptedAt = 0,
	}
end

local function getOrCreateState(player: Player): PlayerState
	local state = playerStates[player.UserId]
	if not state then
		resetStateForPlayer(player)
		state = playerStates[player.UserId]
	end
	return state :: PlayerState
end

local function findDummyModel(): Model?
	local current: Instance = workspace
	for _, segmentName in PunchConfig.DummyModelPath do
		local child = current:FindFirstChild(segmentName)
		if not child then
			return nil
		end
		current = child
	end
	if current:IsA("Model") then
		return current
	end
	return nil
end

local function getDummyHitParts(dummyModel: Model): { BasePart }
	local parts: { BasePart } = {}
	for _, partName in PunchConfig.DummyHitPartNames do
		local part = dummyModel:FindFirstChild(partName)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(parts, part)
		end
	end
	return parts
end

local function ensureHitSound(hitParts: { BasePart }): Sound?
	if hitSound then
		return hitSound
	end
	if #hitParts == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "PunchHitSound"
	sound.SoundId = HIT_SOUND_ASSET_ID
	sound.Looped = false
	sound.Volume = 1
	-- Parented to a real hitbox part already in the replicated workspace, so :Play() calls made
	-- from this server script replicate normally to every connected client.
	sound.Parent = hitParts[1]

	hitSound = sound
	return hitSound
end

local function getPlayerAttackOrigin(player: Player): Vector3?
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if rootPart and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		return rootPart.Position
	end
	if character.PrimaryPart then
		return character.PrimaryPart.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function isWithinRange(originPosition: Vector3, hitParts: { BasePart }): boolean
	for _, part in hitParts do
		local distance = (part.Position - originPosition).Magnitude
		if distance <= PunchConfig.MaxRangeStuds then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function onPunchAttempt(player: Player)
	local state = getOrCreateState(player)

	local now = os.clock()
	if now - state.lastPunchAcceptedAt < PunchConfig.CooldownSeconds then
		-- Reject outright: this player is still inside the server-authoritative cooldown window
		-- (equal to the punch animation duration), regardless of any client-side gating.
		return
	end

	local originPosition = getPlayerAttackOrigin(player)
	if not originPosition then
		return
	end

	local dummyModel = findDummyModel()
	if not dummyModel then
		warn("[PunchValidator] Training dummy model not found at configured DummyModelPath; cannot validate hit.")
		return
	end

	local hitParts = getDummyHitParts(dummyModel)
	if #hitParts == 0 then
		warn("[PunchValidator] Training dummy has no recognized hitbox parts (Head/Torso); cannot validate hit.")
		return
	end

	if not isWithinRange(originPosition, hitParts) then
		-- Miss: attacker was out of MaxRangeStuds range of every dummy hitbox part. This still
		-- consumes a fresh cooldown window (a new swing was genuinely attempted) but the per-player
		-- counter is left completely unchanged, per the "no change on miss" requirement.
		state.lastPunchAcceptedAt = now
		return
	end

	-- Confirmed hit: consume the cooldown window and increment this player's authoritative counter
	-- by exactly 1, then push the new value back to only the attacking client.
	state.lastPunchAcceptedAt = now
	state.hitCount += 1

	-- Audible confirmation (hit_sound requirement): play the approved impact sound immediately on
	-- every confirmed hit. Sound:Play() invoked here on the server replicates to all clients.
	local sound = ensureHitSound(hitParts)
	if sound then
		sound:Play()
	end

	PunchRemotes.CounterUpdated:FireClient(player, state.hitCount)
end

PunchRemotes.PunchAttempt.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, ...: any)
	-- Deliberately ignore any client-supplied arguments (...) -- only the bare "a punch was
	-- attempted" signal is trusted; all position/timing/hit facts are re-derived server-side above.
	onPunchAttempt(player)
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
	resetStateForPlayer(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	playerStates[player.UserId] = nil
end)

-- Cover players already present if this script starts after PlayerAdded already fired for them
-- (e.g. certain Studio test-start orderings), so their state is still correctly initialized.
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	if not playerStates[player.UserId] then
		resetStateForPlayer(player)
	end
end

--!strict
-- Persistent top-right hit counter HUD. Creates a ScreenGui (ResetOnSpawn = false) directly in
-- the local player's PlayerGui, with a Frame (not a bare TextLabel) parented inside it holding the
-- numeric label, per the presentation contract. ResetOnSpawn = false means Roblox's automatic
-- respawn reset will NOT tear down/recreate this ScreenGui on character respawn, so the counter
-- keeps its live value across deaths. As an extra guard against this LocalScript itself ever
-- running more than once for this player (e.g. if something outside our control re-executes it),
-- this script first checks PlayerGui for an already-existing HUD by name and reuses its label
-- instead of constructing a second overlapping ScreenGui/Frame/Label, so there can never be a
-- duplicate or stale HUD visible at once.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
local PunchRemotes = require(sharedRoot:WaitForChild("PunchRemotes")) :: any

local HUD_NAME = "HitCounterHUD"
local FRAME_NAME = "CounterFrame"
local LABEL_NAME = "CounterLabel"

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui

local function findExistingLabel(): TextLabel?
	local existingGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild(HUD_NAME)
	if not existingGui or not existingGui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		return nil
	end
	local existingFrame = existingGui:FindFirstChild(FRAME_NAME)
	if not existingFrame or not existingFrame:IsA("Frame") then
		return nil
	end
	local existingLabel = existingFrame:FindFirstChild(LABEL_NAME)
	if existingLabel and existingLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
		return existingLabel
	end
	return nil
end

local function buildHud(): TextLabel
	local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screenGui.Name = HUD_NAME
	-- Critical for surviving respawns without being reset/recreated by the engine.
	screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

	-- Frame lives inside the ScreenGui (not a bare label directly in PlayerGui), anchored to the
	-- top-right corner of the screen per the environment/theme contract.
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = FRAME_NAME
	frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = screenGui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = frame

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = LABEL_NAME
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	label.Text = "Hits: 0"
	label.Parent = frame

	screenGui.Parent = playerGui

	return label
end

-- Reuse an existing HUD's label if one is already present; otherwise build exactly one.
local counterLabel: TextLabel = findExistingLabel() or buildHud()

local function setCount(count: number)
	counterLabel.Text = string.format("Hits: %d", count)
end

-- Start at 0 immediately on load; the server will push authoritative updates thereafter via
-- CounterUpdated (fired only to this attacking client), so this label always reflects the
-- server-held per-UserId hitCount rather than any locally-guessed value.
setCount(0)

PunchRemotes.CounterUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(newCount: number)
	setCount(newCount)
end)

-- Anchors and positions the retained Training Dummy component so its hitbox
-- matches the location PunchValidator.server.luau checks against.
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local root = Workspace:WaitForChild("Forge_8a81efe9b8ed")
local dummyRoot = root:WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("dummy"):WaitForChild("dummy")
local imported = dummyRoot:WaitForChild("Imported")
local dummyModel = imported:WaitForChild("Training Dummy")

-- Freeze every part of the retained dummy so it never falls, slides or
-- otherwise changes position/state during play.
for _, descendant in ipairs(dummyModel:GetDescendants()) do
	if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
		descendant.Anchored = true
	end
end

spec.assetStrategy: All three approved assets are treated as complete reusable Marketplace components, not raw geometry to rebuild. The Training Dummy (1245720733) is expected to supply the standing hitbox and pose directly; it reports one embedded script, so inspection must review that script before trusting any embedded behavior — only missing integration (server hit validation, sound/counter hookup) will be authored, and any unsafe or unsupported script content will be reported as a review gap rather than silently replaced. The R15 Punching Animations model (12061946559, clip 1/1/18/1) is a raw KeyframeSequence source per the animation capability contract: it is usable for Studio playback via RegisterKeyframeSequence assigned to Animation.AnimationId and played through the player's Animator, with publishing remaining a recorded, non-blocking limitation — no procedural tween substitute will be authored in its place. The impact sound (126976659766267) is a verified Marketplace Audio asset that must pass load/playback/listening checks before being wired to the server-confirmed hit event; no builtin or generated sound will be substituted if it fails. Missing integration to author: RemoteEvent plumbing between client input and server validation, server-side distance/cooldown/hit checks against the dummy's hitbox, sound playback triggered from server-confirmed hits, and a persistent per-player HUD counter — none of which is expected to be supplied by the assets themselves.
spec.title: Punch the Dummy: Combat Trainer
spec.summary: A single-room boxing/dojo practice trainer. On spawn the player stands in a compact ~20x20 stud mat-floored room, facing a stationary training dummy anchored a few studs away at (0,3,15); a hit counter reads '0' in the top-right corner. Walking into melee range and pressing the attack input (left click or bound key) plays a punch animation on the player's arm; the server checks range/aim against the dummy's hitbox, and on a confirmed hit the impact sound plays at the dummy and the counter increments by one, giving the player an immediate, repeatable feedback loop of approach-punch-hear/see-count. A short per-swing cooldown matching the animation length stops duplicate hits from one press. There is no health, retaliation, win condition, or persistence beyond the session — the goal is simply to watch the counter climb. Assumptions applied without further questions: default R15 character with no custom rig, single mouse/keybind attack with no combos, per-player session-only counter with no leaderboard, exactly one dummy with no spawning/respawning, and standard baseplate-style lighting/materials for the gym-style room.
spec.visualDirection: Gritty, approachable gym/dojo training-space aesthetic rather than fantasy or sci-fi. Matte gray/neutral color palette: a mat-textured (or mat-colored) flat floor, simple flat walls or boundary markers, even functional lighting with no dramatic shadows or skybox complexity. The dummy is the visual focal point directly ahead of spawn, tape-wrapped/matte in tone, standing upright on a small anchored base. The HUD counter is a clean, legible numeric label fixed to the top-right corner, high-contrast against the room so it reads at a glance during rapid punching. Punch feedback should be readable: animation swing, synced impact sound at the dummy, and an immediate counter tick, reinforcing a satisfying but minimal training-room loop.
